subject: Evaluation scorecard & exit-gate playbook — draft for Medivue
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Leah Porter <leah.porter@medivue.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@medivue.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation scorecard & exit-gate playbook — draft for Medivue

Hi Leah / Alicia —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As promised, attached is a first draft of the evaluation scorecard and the proposed exit-gate playbook that will guide the 8-week trial. The goal here is to make acceptance objective and to reduce ambiguity during close. High-level:

- Outcome targets (what "success" looks like) with numeric thresholds.
- Exit gates (hard stops) tied to observable telemetry and customer-facing regression checks.
- Acceptance tests (smoke + integration + performance) owners and cadence.
- Rollout / cutover timeline with contingency windows and an A/B canary plan.

Please review the attached 20260504-eval-scorecard.xlsx for the detailed metrics (accuracy, latency P50/P95, availability, cost per 1k tokens under typical slices) and the included checklist. A couple of asks from our side to finalize the MAP this week:

1) Confirm the primary success metric — is patient-identifier concordance at >= 98% the right bar or should we prioritize average prompt-response latency?
2) Who will own the integration smoke tests on your side (API connectivity + auth)?
3) Any internal blackout dates in May/June that would affect cutover?

Attachments: 20260504-eval-scorecard.xlsx (scorecard + pass/fail logic), medivue-smoke-tests-outline.md (test owner checklist).

I'll follow up with an annotated timeline (canary windows + fallback) once I get your input.

Best,
Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0180

--

Note: This email starts the MAP thread for the Medivue pilot; internal owners cc'd for triage and acceptance-runbook ownership.

From: Dr. Leah Porter <leah.porter@medivue.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@medivue.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 13:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation scorecard & exit-gate playbook — draft for Medivue

Markus —

Thanks for the draft. Quick answers inline:

1) Primary metric: concordance on patient-matching at >= 97.5% — we can stretch to 98% but let's set 97.5% as firm for the first gate.
2) Integration owner: Alicia will own API connectivity (auth + schema validation). I'll own clinical-safety validation and concordance checks.
3) Blackout windows: None in May; June 7–11 we have a major release freeze.

We reviewed the scorecard and have two requests:
- Add an explicit regression budget for hallucination-like errors (we call them "miscategorization events") — max 0.5% per 10k requests.
- Add a cadence for manual review sampling: weekly 200-case random sample for the first 4 weeks.

We'll do a 30-minute sync tomorrow to finalize owners. Can Alicia join at 10am PT?

Leah

Dr. Leah Porter
VP Clinical Ops, Medivue Health
leah.porter@medivue.com

--

On quoting:

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Leah Porter <leah.porter@medivue.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@medivue.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation scorecard & exit-gate playbook — draft for Medivue (updated)

Thanks Leah — helpful clarifications. I've incorporated your asks and updated the scorecard:

- Patient-concordance gate set to 97.5% for Gate 1; stretch target 98% for Gate 2.
- Added "miscategorization" regression budget = 0.5% per 10k requests and a weekly random-sample review.
- Marked June 7–11 as a blackout — we'll avoid any schedule-critical cutovers in that window.

I've also sketched the acceptance tests and owners here (excerpted):

Acceptance tests (owners / cadence):
- API connectivity (Alicia, Medivue) — smoke every deploy, owner confirms within 1 business hour.
- Inference latency P95 < 450ms (SRE/Redwood) — automated load probe, measured daily.
- Token-cost regression < 10% vs baseline (Redwood Optimize) — weekly report.
- Clinical concordance spot-check (Leah / Medivue) — weekly 200-sample for first 4 weeks, then 100-sample.
- Fail-fast gate: if patient-concordance drops >1.5 pts vs baseline or miscategorization >1% in a 24h window, automated rollback and paging to both teams.

Attached: updated 20260505-eval-scorecard.xlsx (v2) and the smoke-test outline.

Next steps:
- Alicia to confirm connectivity owner and provide a contact by tomorrow EOD.
- Priyom to schedule a single-run smoke test with Alicia (pre-prod) on Friday.
- Camila / Soojin to finalize the canary windows and specify traffic split (10% then 50%).

If we agree, I'll convert this into a mutual action plan (MAP) with explicit dates and the DocuSign SOW link for the trial.

Best,
Markus

Attachments referenced: 20260505-eval-scorecard.xlsx, medivue-smoke-tests-outline.md

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Dr. Leah Porter <leah.porter@medivue.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@medivue.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation scorecard & exit-gate playbook — draft for Medivue (finalized plan)

Folks —

Quick update after internal review (finalized items):

1) Canary plan: Week 1 — 10% traffic for 48 hours; Week 2 — 50% for 72 hours; Week 3 — full rollout pending Gate 2 signoff. Rollback window: 30 minutes after detected regression.
2) Automated smoke suite will run on every deploy (connectivity, schema, auth). Results posted to the MAP doc and healthcheck endpoint.
3) Acceptance timeline (dates):
   - May 10: Pre-prod smoke run (Alicia + Priyom)
   - May 12–18: Week 1 canary (10%)
   - May 19–25: Week 2 canary (50%)
   - May 26: Gate 1 review meeting (decision: proceed / pause)
   - June 2: Gate 2 review meeting (final acceptance or extension)

4) Evidence pack required for each gate: weekly concordance report, automated latency/cost reports, and 200-case manual sample summary (Leah).

I've uploaded the finalized MAP and the DocuSign SOW draft to the shared drive: https://docs.redwood.ai/drive/medivue-eval-playbook (link in metadata).

Alicia — please confirm you can run the May 10 pre-prod smoke and provide the API key rotation timeline (if any).

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
